pending_review_fixes: tools/r6_budget.py:reserve omits used.automatic_model_sessions from the combined protected-session calculation (other_models). A read-only, in-memory counterexample with 10 used sessions and a 15-session confirmation_delivery reservation is accepted, leaving 7 although final_review=4 and repair=4 remain protected. The individual role checks do not enforce the combined reserve. Include purpose-aware historical usage in protection accounting, or conservatively include unclassified used sessions; test nonzero used balances and serialization.

tools/r6_model_worker.py:run cleanup only signals the child group while proc.poll() is None and owns(child) remains true. If the CLI leader exits while a descendant remains, cleanup skips that descendant. A descendant retaining stdout can trigger the timeout yet survive the finalizer; one closing its pipes can survive an apparently successful receipt. Journal.observe checks the worker identity, not surviving child descendants. Track and reconcile owned descendants independently of leader liveness, require verified cleanup before reporting completion, and test leader exit with a surviving CPU child. This is an implemented worker-cleanup defect, distinct from the undeployed controller.

tools/r6_model_worker.py:run enforces a before-write limit only for streamed stdout/stderr. The CLI writes last-message.json directly without that bound, and receipt.json is written after the final size check. usage() copies every reported usage object into the receipt, potentially duplicating a substantial part of the bounded event log and exceeding the overall cap. Enforce bounds on all worker artifacts, reserve bounded receipt space, and test oversized final messages and many usage records. Polling file size after writes does not establish a hard output cap.

isaaclab-training/instinctlab/observations/robustness.py:RangeDelivery.deliver draws only validity.sum() noise samples and assigns them in valid-beam order. Consequently, different policy-dependent validity masks change both beam-to-draw assignment and subsequent RNG state despite identical stream identities. This does not implement the common measurement-noise realization promised for paired baseline/final comparisons in TEST_PROTOCOL.json and SPLIT_MANIFEST.json. Use noise indexed independently by condition/lane/acquisition/beam, applying it only to valid beams. Test shared-beam noise and later frames under differing validity masks; identical-input reproducibility alone is insufficient.
